signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.recordChecks:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.recordChecks : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext →
  Option ℕ → ℕ → Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord → List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.historyCheck:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.historyChecksFrom : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext →
  Option ℕ → ℕ → List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord → List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult

Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.historyChecks : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext →
  List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord → List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.fullAudit:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.fullAudit : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext →
  List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord → List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedRepla:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedReplay : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext →
  List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord →
    List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult × Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult × Option ℕ
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.content_chai:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.content_chain_replay : ∀ (state : ℕ)
  (records : List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord),
  Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.transitionChain state records →
    Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.replayStored state records =
      Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.runKnown (List.map Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord.value records) state
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.history_yes_:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.history_yes_chain : ∀ (c : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext) (previous : Option ℕ)
  (expectedState : ℕ) (records : List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord),
  (∀ (check : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult),
      check ∈ Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.historyChecksFrom c previous expectedState records →
        check = Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult.yes) →
    Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.transitionChain expectedState records
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.admitted_ful:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.admitted_fullAudit_implies_transitionChain : ∀
  (c : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext) (records : List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord),
  Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.admitted (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.fullAudit c records) = Bool.true →
    Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.transitionChain c.initialState records
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedRepla:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedReplay_success_matches_runKnown : ∀ (c : Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.ReplayContext)
  (records : List Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord) (output : ℕ),
  (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedReplay c records).snd.fst = Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult.yes →
    (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedReplay c records).snd.snd = Option.some output →
      output =
        Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.runKnown (List.map Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.PathRecord.value records)
          c.initialState
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknown_is_r:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknown_is_retained_and_fails_closed : (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.recordChecks
        Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.sampleContext Option.none 0
        Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknownEvidenceRecord).getLast? =
    Option.some (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult.unknown "signature check unavailable") ∧
  Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.admitted
      (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.recordChecks Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.sampleContext Option.none 0
        Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknownEvidenceRecord) =
    Bool.false
signatures.Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknown_evid:
Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknown_evidence_declines_with_reason : (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedReplay
          Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.sampleContext [Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknownEvidenceRecord]).snd.fst =
    Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult.unknown "signature check unavailable" ∧
  (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedReplay Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.sampleContext
            [Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknownEvidenceRecord]).snd.snd =
      Option.none ∧
    (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.checkedReplay Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.sampleContext
              [Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.unknownEvidenceRecord]).fst.contains
        (Experiments.Pal24SourcePath.CheckResult.unknown "signature check unavailable") =
      Bool.true
